title: Journey Timeline & Adaptive Side Quests
changes: Reworked Journey into a single vertical learning timeline showing recent lessons, the current lesson, required side quests and upcoming lessons together.
The timeline supports touch swiping and mouse wheel/drag scrolling.
Required side quests are inserted only when a lesson checkpoint shows that extra practice is needed, then the same lesson is queued for retry.
Side quests are visually shown in the Journey timeline and are not treated as a separate learning path.
Removed Quick Reviews from the main Journey presentation; normal spaced review remains part of lessons and the underlying learning system.
Cleaned up Journey wording so Sensei no longer talks about the old village/activity-first structure.
Replaced the old Today's route complete messaging with lesson-focused completion language.
Added migration/normalisation for oversized legacy Journey history entries so history does not claim an entire lesson's catalogue was learned in one session.
Improved Japan Ready cheat-sheet speech playback, including delayed voice loading and speechSynthesis resume handling.
Japan Ready remains a separate path and its existing scenario system is preserved.
